question:
**Select the most appropriate option for the given group of words.**

The original natives of a country
solution:
The correct answer is '**Aborigines**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Aborigines**'.
 
• It means **'a member of the original people to inhabit an area especially as contrasted with an invading or colonizing people; a person, animal, or plant that has been in a country or region from earliest times'.** (मूल निवासी)
